canonical_statement: For every atom type, premise set, and finitary propositional formula over false and implication, if every two-valued Boolean valuation satisfying all premises satisfies the formula, then the formula is derivable from the premises in the fixed classical Hilbert calculus with assumption, K, S, double-negation elimination, and modus ponens rules.
domain_and_universes: universe u; Atom : Type u; Formula Atom is freely generated by atom, falsum, and implication; Gamma : Set (Formula Atom); phi : Formula Atom; valuations have type Atom -> Bool
hypotheses: SemanticallyEntails Gamma phi: every valuation satisfying every member of Gamma evaluates phi to true
conclusion: Derives Gamma phi in the explicitly encoded classical Hilbert calculus.
connective_basis: falsum and implication; negation is implication to falsum and classicality is supplied by double-negation elimination

killed: changed arbitrary atom type to Nat
moved the premise-set binder under a stronger antecedent
changed arbitrary Set contexts to finite List contexts

degenerate_cases: Arbitrary atom types, including Empty, and arbitrary premise sets are admitted. Empty premises do not entail an arbitrary atom; a premise set containing falsum semantically entails every formula; premise membership creates a derivation leaf.
excluded_cases: Ambient Lean Prop, intuitionistic, modal, first-order, many-valued, and infinitary object languages are excluded. Empty-context tautological completeness and finite-list consequence are uncredited mutations rather than substitutes.
foundation_profile: The target itself is an object-language implication in Lean Prop. Object-level classicality is explicit in axiomDNE; no proof of the target or foundation/axiom closure is claimed at this phase.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates the exact general-premise completeness target and fixed calculus. It supplies statement evidence only; source fidelity, anchor audit, proof, trust, and theorem completion remain open.
